maya (devex): heads up: new users hit an ambiguous error during streaming auth failures. SDK surfaces "Error: Request failed" with no status or retry hint, and support is getting tickets.

irene (eng): is that the raw API body or our proxy response? paste terminal copy if you have it.

maya (devex): terminal shows HTTP/1.1 400 and JSON body { "error": "Request failed" } — no structured fields. SDK just throws a plain Error.

tom (sdk): ack. current SDK code does throw new Error(body.error || statusText). No typed exceptions or retry meta.

sam (pm): this hurts onboarding. Proposal: structured error envelope with fields: type, message, status, code, retry_after, retryable. SDKs should map to typed classes: RateLimitError, AuthError, BadRequestError, ServerError and include a human-facing hint.

chris (sre): strongly +1. Right now clients retry blindly and cause thundering during incidents. If SDK exposes retry_after or retryable flag we can avoid cascades.

irene (eng): we already send X-Retry-After header on some routes. I suggest body-first, header fallback for compatibility with proxies. Also add error.code string for programmatic mapping.

maya (devex): also need streaming contract: error frames that include the same JSON envelope so sample-apps can show try/catch patterns for streaming.

tom (sdk): plan from SDK side: 1) parse body envelope, fallback to headers; 2) implement typed exceptions with fields status/code/retry_after/retryable/hint; 3) update quickstart and sample-apps with examples and copy; 4) add e2e tests simulating object errors. Minor semver bump.

sam (pm): give me one-line remediation copy per error class for docs. Example: 401 -> "Verify API key and region routing; rotate key if necessary." 429 -> "Backoff or reduce concurrency; honor retry_after."

tom (sdk): will draft the copy and include catch examples in TS/Py. Example TS: try { await client.generate() } catch (e) { if (e instanceof RateLimitError && e.retry_after) await sleep(e.retry_after*1000) }

release-bot: scheduled-release-note: "SDK: richer error surface with typed exceptions and retry hints (minor)"

maya (devex): assigning follow-ups: tom (SDK PR), irene (backend parity validator), chris (SRE test harness), maya (quickstart + samples).

irene (eng): will add backend validator to ensure error objects include status and code.

chris (sre): will add load test scenario to ensure clients respect retry_after and avoid cascading retries. :+1:

maya (devex): thanks all — small contract but should cut newbie tickets and reduce incident churn. :party_parrot:
